title: Expose authorized legacy print templates through a reusable controlled binding catalog
description: Users need to discover and bind existing saved print templates to compatible controlled report datasets without leaking unauthorized bill families or executing layout expressions. Implement bounded read-only template catalog and finite family/field-alias mapping used by generic output workflows; existing template writes remain unchanged. Stage 2 only. Keep legacy routes until every migration is genuinely accepted. No production, secrets/env, arbitrary SQL, permission expansion, new schema or unrelated refactor. Preserve concurrent work.
acceptance_criteria: Enumerate active SysPrintTemplates through a bounded authenticated catalog with current existing menu authorization and closed BillType mappings from actual PrintTemplateController PrintableTitles and LegacyBillExportCatalog. Every template/family is represented as compatible or explicit unsupported, never falsely parity-passed. Preserve saved template identity/default/order/paper/font/header/footer settings; no template writes or permission grants.

For supported families use exact existing controlled dataset keys and finite legacy field aliases; recheck provider catalog column permissions on each binding request. Reject unknown/unauthorized field aliases, incompatible datasets, malformed/oversized FieldKeys/LayoutJson and unavailable ownership mappings. Unsupported master/quotation/PI families remain explicit blockers rather than guessed joins or silent fallback.

Integrate finite print-template families into migration registry with genuine compatibility statuses and fail-closed retirement. Unit and guarded isolated SQL tests cover nonempty saved templates, exact menu denials, unsupported families, field ordering and alias injection; related tests, safe Release and scheduler self-test/contracts. Real browser/database limitations remain accurately unaccepted.
implementation_evidence: PrintTemplateController.cs PrintableTitles covers 16 bill families plus 7 master families, quotation, proforma-invoice and doc-center; SysPrintTemplate includes FieldKeys/LayoutJson and print options. ReportMigrationRegistryDtos only has trade print/export entries; no controlled saved print-template binding catalog exists in source/tasks. LegacyBillExportCatalog now provides finite bill dataset/menu mappings.
